headline: Deshae Frost was SHOCKED as he watched DDG call for a new streamer award show of his own a
body: Deshae Frost was SHOCKED as he watched DDG call for a new streamer award show of his own after he reportedly missed out in the music category. DDG kept choosing his words carefully, but Deshae didn't hold back and spoke up loudly with his own take on it. DDG then said he noticed a lot of people at the show he didn't even know, and that plenty of them didn't know him either.
